blind.description: A stylized fantasy/medieval straight wall segment constructed from wattle and daub, bounded on the top and bottom by thick dark-brown timber beams. The plaster face has cracks and broken holes revealing the horizontal woven wooden wattle slats beneath. One face features a small reinforced loop or fixture, embedded decorative pebbles/daub studs, and a patched rectangular section near the base. The surfaces are solid, stylized, and continuous with no floating or disconnected elements. It rests flat on its bottom beam without an added base or plinth.
blind.from_above: a dark brown rectangular horizontal timber beam spanning the top of the wall
blind.height_vs_figure: roughly 6 to 6.5 ft tall (slightly taller than the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 3.5 to 4 ft wide

notes: small loop fixture and pebble details on one face
